sentences.text: A strong wall can protect a town from the wind and rain.
I draw a red triangle with three straight sides.
I propose that we all go to the sea this summer.

Our class had a funny Halloween game. We did a big stretch, then froze while standing like statues. Anything could make us laugh! Some children made terrible, silly faces, while others tried to keep themselves still. Even our teacher joined in the fun.

I built a long toy train from my blocks. Each segment was a different colour. It looked so strange that my cat did not recognise it! I used magnets and simple technology to help the parts stay together. I suppose the best part is that I can build it in many original ways.
I worked very hard on my science project all through the week.
The kind staff at the shop always give very good service.
I read the first section of my new book before bed tonight.

On rest days, my family likes to make bread at home. We prepare the dough together in the kitchen. My job is to measure the milk, sugar and honey. Mum says it is necessary to wait for the dough to rise. Soon, it begins to increase in size. We usually share some bread with the family next door. Making bread together is always fun!

Every morning, my family has breakfast together. We talk about our day, from the fun things to the serious ones. I tell them about my exercise plans after school. Mum and Dad tell us about their day too. Together, we determine who will do each job at home. It is a nice way to start and continue our day as a team.
We pick a big pumpkin and paint it for Halloween.
Each of my books has a different story to tell.
New technology helps us learn in fun ways at school.

A new student joined our class this week. We gave him a warm welcome, and I was asked to introduce him to the class. I showed him around the school building. We soon found that we had a similar interest in dinosaurs! I was happy to have someone new to talk to. I now consider him a good friend.

This year, our school will establish a community garden. A small committee asked each class to contribute an idea. I suggest that we grow corn, flowers and one giant pumpkin! A garden is good for the environment and gives bees a place to visit. Plants require good soil, sun and water, so we must maintain the garden each day. Whether it rains or shines, our purpose is the same: to work together and watch our plants grow.
I represent my school in the big running race this year.
There is a big difference between my two dogs.
The fresh bread from the market is of very high quality.

A magician came to our school this Christmas! He asked for a helper, and the class picked me. He announced my name, and I approached the stage carefully. He touched my shoulder, and a rainbow hat suddenly appeared! My whole class laughed, especially my best friend. Although I knew it was a trick, it still felt like real magic. I tried to identify how he did it, but I could not. Whatever the secret was, it was probably the best show ever!

Our class wrote a storybook this term. Every child added a character to the written story. My character speaks a funny language made up of silly words! A minister who visited our school received the first copy. We were proud of our final product, and watching others read it made us smile. One day, I hope to study writing at a university.
The teacher will publish our best stories in a little class book.
The kind staff are nice to every customer at the shop.
It is possible that we will see a rainbow after the rain.

This week, we learned about division and fractions. Our teacher wrote an equation on the board and showed us how to find the quotient. We also learned to subtract and find the difference quickly. There are various ways to solve a sum. I realise that it is possible to learn maths without too much pressure. I just keep trying, and maths is becoming my favourite class!

In class, we learned how a strong structure is built. Every material must be tested, and each surface must be strong and safe. A bridge must protect the thousands of people who use it. Its main function is to provide a safe way across the water. Workers look for any sign of trouble and check that the bridge is in good condition. After looking at previous designs, I want to propose something of my own one day!
We went to visit my uncle at his farm yesterday.
I introduce my new friend to my family.
The farmers provide fresh food for the busy local market.

My uncle works as a doctor at the hospital in our community. Last week, our class went there to say thank you. He showed us some tools and told us about his work. Doctors sometimes have to make a difficult decision to help someone who is sick. The people at the hospital are a good influence on me. I hope to help others one day too.

Everyone at school was looking forward to the big race. I practise running in the park every afternoon because doing my best is important to me. My family came to support me, and I took my position at the starting line. Suddenly, the race began! I ran as fast as I could and crossed the line first. It was a great success. “You should be proud of yourself,” said my teacher.
I found the solution to the problem and felt very happy.
Each individual student worked hard and the whole class did well.
We watch a fun show on the television after dinner.

Our class visited a television station in the city. We watched a children’s programme being made and saw how the team worked together. Everyone had to keep a high standard of quality. A woman was talking on the telephone about the stories for tonight. At the end, the station president shook our hands. I thought about that exciting day all the way home.

In class, we chose a science subject for a project. My specific question was about how plants grow. I did research and collected data each day. Soon, I began to understand the problem and look for a solution. I used the computer to organise my notes into a separate section for each week. Then I wrote my complete report. The whole process taught me a lot, and I received an excellent mark!
The school committee plans the big summer party for the children.
I read a wonderful book about dinosaurs last night.
Our whole community works together to keep the park clean.

It is a family tradition to celebrate every birthday together. This year, everybody planned a special surprise for Grandma. Mum made a delicious chocolate cake, and I wrote her a birthday letter. When Grandma arrived, we all shouted, “Surprise!” She said it was a wonderful occasion to remember. I will always keep that happy day in my heart.

Yesterday, we drove a long distance to visit Grandpa’s village. The weather was warm, and the mountain behind his house looked beautiful. We walked through the forest and saw a little squirrel gathering food. There were flowers everywhere! I wrote a short paragraph about everything I saw, so I can describe the experience to my class tomorrow.
